switches.summary: Linear five-pin mechanical switch with a manufacturer-published 67 g bottom-out force, 3.8 mm total travel and factory lubrication.

sources.label: Wuque Studio WS Switch Series product page

specification.note: Wuque Studio publishes WS Red as a linear five-pin switch with Nylon top/bottom housings, POM stem, 22 mm double-stage spring, 3.80±0.3 mm total travel, 67 g bottom-out force and factory lubrication. Atlas stores the published g-force convention as gf in the typed force field.
